name: postward-local-media-gen
description: Generate and transform images, video and speech locally, on the user's own NVIDIA GPU, with no hosted service involved.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and transform images, video and speech locally on your own NVIDIA GPU.
interface.longDescription: Local-first media generation for a workstation's own NVIDIA GPU, with no hosted service involved. Covers text-to-image, image-to-image, masked inpainting that preserves pixels outside the mask, text-to-video and image-to-video, RTX video upscaling, and speech synthesis with long-form dialogue. Serialises GPU work through one lease so a consumer-sized card is never oversubscribed, and reports what the machine can actually do before asking it to generate anything.
defaultPrompt: Check what this workstation can do before generating anything: run `python scripts/doctor.py` from the skill directory.
Generate an image, a video, or speech locally, following the operating contract in SKILL.md.
Perform a masked edit that preserves pixels outside the mask, then verify the seam.
